payload.summary: Phone-chrome reserve shift is FIXED on main (PR #2929); the residual is the ui-tools shard-3 settle assertion, not the product defect
payload.detail: CAUSE FOUND AND PROVEN 2026-09-20; NO LONGER PARKED. This is not a flaky test — it catches a real phone defect that also hits clinicians. The Differentials mode-nav row (49px) paints IN page flow, then ModeNavHeaderPortal moves it into the fixed phone header at ~315ms; content loses that height and every element rises 49px. usePhoneOverlayChromeReserve only republishes the measured 121px at ~423ms, so for ~110ms the whole page sits 49px too high. A press that straddles that correction lands on one control and releases on another: recorded trace shows pointerdown on the compare-open link at y 492-540, pointerup at the identical y hitting "Edit selection" because the link had moved to 443-491, and the browser retargeting the click to their common ancestor. The link never activates — no error, no navigation. scrollY is 0 throughout, so this is layout, not scrolling, and Playwright hit-target checks cannot see it because press and release were each individually on a real element. EVIDENCE: 0/41 reproductions through the repo runner (10x alone, 10x under 4 busy loops, 20x under 12, plus a full shard) — shard load is not the right kind of slowness. Under Chrome DevTools renderer throttling: 0/10 at 4x, 10/10 at 10x, 9/10 at 20x, and 0/10 at 10x when the phone chrome is allowed to settle first. That last row is the control. TWO CORRECTIONS TO THIS ROW. (1) It is the PHONE click that fails, not the desktop one. tests/ui-tools.spec.ts:2928 is the test declaration; the test contains two compare-open clicks, and the URL CI recorded has no q=Pain, which matches the 390x844 phone block. Above the phone breakpoint the reserve publishes 0px and no addon row mounts, so desktop is not exposed. (2) The TO-UNBLOCK suggestion in this row does not work and is refuted: the destination "Loading presentation" role=status skeleton cannot be the settle signal, because it lives inside the destination route and only renders AFTER the URL commits. Proven by holding the destination response 20s — urlChangedAfterMs 20130, loadingSkeletonSeenAfterMs null. The "racing an unhydrated link" hypothesis is the right family but the wrong mechanism: the link is a plain next/link anchor from a Server Component, so a pre-hydration click would still navigate natively. The race is hydration-driven LAYOUT, not handlers. PRODUCT FIX LANDED as PR #2929, merged 2026-09-20 (commit 80cf3df6c69a); verified on origin/main, where publishPhoneOverlayChromeReserveNow appears in globals.css, phone-header-collapse-portal.tsx and use-phone-overlay-chrome-reserve.ts. THE PRODUCT DEFECT IS FIXED AND MUST NOT BE REDONE - the only residual is the test-side settle assertion named below. Originally recorded as merely OPENED (publishPhoneOverlayChromeReserveNow — the portals now publish the reserve in the same commit that removes the row from flow). A test-side settle assertion per docs/search-chrome-behaviour.md is still worth adding afterwards so the test is robust independently, but was deliberately NOT bundled with the product fix, because landing both together would hide whether the product fix works.
